_comment: The crz-cockpit palettes, expressed as OmaCar themes.
The cockpit prototype defines its look as raw CSS custom properties --
thirty-odd output tokens per palette, written by hand. OmaCar's themes are
eight source colours and a mode, and everything the app paints with is
derived from those by lib/theme.py, which is where the contrast floors
live: where `faint` is walked until it clears 5:1 on the surface it will
actually sit on, where a warning is pulled until it survives sunlight.
So these are ported as SOURCES, not as output. A palette that is beautiful
on a Mac at a desk and illegible through a windscreen at noon is the exact
failure the derivation exists to prevent, and pasting the cockpit's
finished tokens in would have walked straight past it.
background / foreground / accent are the cockpit's own --background,
--foreground and --mint. red, green and blue carry the drive-mode accents
DESIGN-NOTES.md names: SPORT red, ECON green, NORMAL blue. yellow and
